slides.title: Aldergate Trust — Neighbourhood Futures Logic Model

columns.heading: RESOURCES
items: A neighbourhood office staffed five days a week
Two vans maintained for the mobile pantry route

columns.heading: ACTIVITIES
items: After-school homework club running four evenings a week
Saturday football coaching for eight to twelve year olds
Mobile pantry stops at six estates every Thursday
Benefits advice drop-in every second Tuesday morning

columns.heading: OUTPUTS
items: Sixty homework club places filled each term
Twelve coaching sessions delivered every month
Four hundred pantry visits recorded across the year

columns.heading: SHORT-TERM OUTCOMES
items: Homework club attenders hand in assignments on time more often
Pantry users report spending less of their income on food

columns.heading: LONG-TERM OUTCOMES
items: Aldergate children move through secondary school without falling behind
Sustained Community Impact across the six estates the trust serves
